mapper.sql: d.id, d.doc_no, d.kind, d.order_id, d.partner_id, d.warehouse_id, d.biz_date, d.total_qty, d.total_amount, d.tax_amount, d.wms_doc_id, d.wms_doc_no, d.remark, d.replenish, d.discount_amount, d.discount_adjust, d.freight, d.freight_bearer, d.freight_cost, d.carrier_supplier_id, d.freight_bill_id, d.freight_settle, d.freight_account_id, d.freight_partner_bill_id, d.freight_io_id, cs.name AS carrier_supplier_name, d.dept_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.post_by, d.post_time, pu.nickname AS post_by_name, o.order_no, o.source AS order_source, CASE WHEN o.source = 'DIRECT' THEN o.whole_discount END AS whole_discount, o.invoice_kind, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) AS partner_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name

FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND sp.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer cu ON o.kind = 'SALES' AND cu.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier cs ON cs.id = d.carrier_supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = d.post_by
mapper.select: SELECT ti.doc_id AS "docId", ti.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.name AS "warehouseName" FROM scm_trade_doc_item ti LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = ti.warehouse_id WHERE ti.doc_id IN #{id} GROUP BY ti.doc_id, ti.warehouse_id, w.name
